prompt: Name a feature film directed by Steven Spielberg.

answers.name: Jaws
answers.fact: Shot on open water against everyone's advice; the shark broke down so often it barely appears.

answers.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
answers.fact: The crew shot largely in sequence so the child actors' goodbyes would be real.

answers.name: Jurassic Park
answers.fact: Spielberg cut it remotely from Poland while beginning Schindler's List.

answers.name: Schindler's List
answers.fact: He refused a salary, calling it blood money.

answers.name: Raiders of the Lost Ark
answers.fact: Conceived with George Lucas on a beach in Hawaii while waiting on Star Wars reviews.

answers.name: Saving Private Ryan
answers.fact: The Omaha Beach landing runs about 24 minutes and was shot in Ireland.

answers.name: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
answers.fact: The five-note phrase was chosen from hundreds John Williams wrote as candidates.

answers.name: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
answers.fact: Sean Connery was cast as the father despite being only twelve years older than Harrison Ford.

answers.name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
answers.fact: So grim on release that it helped push the American ratings board to invent PG-13.

answers.name: Catch Me If You Can
answers.fact: Based on Frank Abagnale's account of himself, much of which has since been questioned.

answers.name: Minority Report
answers.fact: The gesture interface was designed by consultants who later built real versions of it.

answers.name: Lincoln
answers.fact: Daniel Day-Lewis based the voice on descriptions of it as reedy and high, not sonorous.

answers.name: War of the Worlds
answers.fact: Made quickly after Wells' novel had sat with Spielberg since childhood.

answers.name: Hook
answers.fact: Spielberg has repeatedly said he dislikes it.

answers.name: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
answers.fact: His only sequel to his own film until Crystal Skull.

answers.name: West Side Story
answers.fact: His first musical, made at 74, with no subtitles on the Spanish dialogue by design.

answers.name: The Fabelmans
answers.fact: A version of his own childhood and his parents' divorce.

answers.name: Munich
answers.fact: Written by Tony Kushner, who went on to write Lincoln and West Side Story for him.

answers.name: The Color Purple
answers.fact: Whoopi Goldberg's first film role; it took eleven nominations and won nothing.

answers.name: The Terminal
answers.fact: Loosely inspired by Mehran Karimi Nasseri, who lived for years in Charles de Gaulle airport.

answers.name: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
answers.fact: Inherited from Stanley Kubrick, who had developed it for years before his death.

answers.name: Bridge of Spies
answers.fact: The Coen brothers rewrote the script.

answers.name: Empire of the Sun
answers.fact: Christian Bale's first film, at thirteen, from J.G. Ballard's account of his own internment.

answers.name: War Horse
answers.fact: Adapted from the stage play, and shot on Dartmoor.

answers.name: The Post
answers.fact: Written, shot and released inside nine months.

answers.name: Amistad
answers.fact: Anthony Hopkins delivered a seven-page courtroom speech in a single take.

answers.name: The Adventures of Tintin
answers.fact: His only animated feature, made with performance capture alongside Peter Jackson.
His first flop, and the reason he says he learned to control a budget.

answers.name: Always
answers.fact: A remake of the 1943 film A Guy Named Joe, and Audrey Hepburn's last screen role.

answers.name: Duel
answers.fact: Made for television in 1971 and released to cinemas overseas. The truck driver is never shown.
